methodology.weekBoundary: Monday 00:00 UTC through the following Monday 00:00 UTC
methodology.ranking: Distinct source-native wallets with at least one successful top-level call to a reviewed app contract in the last completed week
methodology.tezosWallet: Implicit tz1-tz4 sender on an applied nonce-free TzKT transaction
methodology.etherlinkWallet: Nonzero EVM from address on a successful inbound Blockscout transaction
methodology.allLayerIdentity: Tezos and Etherlink wallets are prefixed by layer and summed as wallet-layer identities; no cross-layer ownership is inferred
methodology.interaction: One unique top-level operation or EVM transaction hash
methodology.retention: Share of the previous completed week wallet cohort returning in the current completed week
methodology.yoy: Change from the weekday-aligned week beginning 52 weeks earlier
methodology.caveat: Wallets are pseudonymous addresses, not people. Automation and multi-wallet behavior are not inferred away. Alias-based L1 families are exhaustively resolved from paged TzKT smart-contract and asset rows, frozen and retained append-only across refreshes; a new match rebuilds from its first eligible week. The ranking covers only that disclosed contract universe.
